still open after round 2, both approve
no session and no can check yet; every run goes to every tab
the log reader does not check the file's owner; Task 25 needs it
a delta frame has no size bound: a large scatter, 32 slow tabs
a time bound on schema patterns, now FU-P3-20
the OpenAPI snapshot is untyped, and holds the package version
the task cursor repeats the ID: a cursor format to decide
